rules.name: fair_redeem_custom
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and wide(ret) * pre("totalSupply") > wide(arg(0)) * pre("TokenC01.balanceOf", A0)

rules.name: fair_deposit_custom
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret) * pre("TokenC01.balanceOf", A0) > wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")

rules.name: first_deposit_one_to_one
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and pre("totalSupply") == 0 and ret != arg(0)

rules.name: share_price_monotone_custom
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("TokenC01.balanceOf", A0)) * pre("totalSupply") < wide(pre("TokenC01.balanceOf", A0)) * post("totalSupply")
rules.why: assets per share never drop for remaining holders

rules.name: deposit_nonzero
rules.why: depositing assets must mint shares (inflation attack)

rules.name: deposit_assets_in
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and post("TokenC01.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC01.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0)
rules.why: vault receives exactly the deposited assets

rules.name: deposit_payer_pays
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and post("TokenC01.balanceOf", sender) + arg(0) != pre("TokenC01.balanceOf", sender)

rules.name: deposit_supply_up
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") + ret

rules.name: deposit_receiver_credit
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and post("balanceOf", arg(1)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(1)) + ret

rules.name: redeem_supply_down
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and post("totalSupply") + arg(0) != pre("totalSupply")

rules.name: redeem_owner_debit
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and post("balanceOf", arg(2)) + arg(0) != pre("balanceOf", arg(2))

rules.name: redeem_assets_out
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and arg(1) != A0 and post("TokenC01.balanceOf", A0) + ret != pre("TokenC01.balanceOf", A0)

rules.name: redeem_receiver_paid
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and arg(1) != A0 and post("TokenC01.balanceOf", arg(1)) != pre("TokenC01.balanceOf", arg(1)) + ret

rules.name: redeem_allowance_spent
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and sender != arg(2) and pre("allowance", arg(2), sender) != 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935 and post("allowance", arg(2), sender) + arg(0) != pre("allowance", arg(2), sender)
rules.why: third-party redeem spends exactly the shares of allowance

rules.name: redeem_needs_allowance
rules.expr: ok and called("redeem") and sender != arg(2) and pre("allowance", arg(2), sender) < arg(0)
rules.why: cannot redeem others' shares beyond allowance

rules.name: share_loss_allowance
rules.why: others can take shares only up to allowance

rules.name: share_loss_custom
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("balanceOf", u) < pre("balanceOf", u) and pre("balanceOf", u) > post("balanceOf", u) + pre("allowance", u, sender)

rules.name: asset_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("redeem") or called("transfer") or called("approve")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC01.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC01.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: vault calls never take underlying from non-callers

rules.name: transfer_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and arg(0) != sender and (post("balanceOf", sender) + arg(0) != pre("balanceOf", sender) or post("balanceOf", arg(0)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) + arg(0))

rules.name: approve_sets
rules.expr: ok and called("approve") and post("allowance", sender, arg(0)) != arg(1)

rules.name: approve_no_balance
rules.expr: ok and called("approve") and post("balanceOf", u) != pre("balanceOf", u)

rules.name: redeem_works

params.condition: sender == arg(2) and arg(0) > 0 and arg(0) <= pre("balanceOf", sender) and arg(1) != A0

rules.why: owner can always redeem own shares

params.condition: arg(0) > 0 and arg(0) <= pre("TokenC01.balanceOf", sender) and arg(0) <= pre("TokenC01.allowance", sender, A0) and arg(0) <= 1000000 and sender != A0

invariants.name: backed
invariants.why: outstanding shares always backed by assets
